name: Insider dealing on inside information
description: Staff or counterparty trades on material non-public information ahead of announcement.

name: Unlawful disclosure of inside information
description: Inside information shared selectively (analyst tipping, partner leakage, social media slip).

name: Market manipulation (spoofing / wash / layering)
description: Trading desk or customer engages in spoofing, wash trades or layering on a venue or token pair.

name: Suspicious-trade order report (STOR) not filed
description: Surveillance flags a suspicious order or trade and no STOR / equivalent is filed to the NCA.
